description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

1 Action (1 scrap): Restore 2d4+4 HP.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Restore 3d6+6 HP.

Passive: You regain +INT HP when drinking healing potions or Elixir H's.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Restores 2d4+4 HP, plus your INT from the passive.

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elixir H (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elixir H" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Thrown to an ally with Shared Elixirs, the passive doesn't apply — subtract your INT.
